purpose: Canonical tariff/enrichment contract attached to PAN IRVE physical stations and PDCs

sourceModes.station_evse: source exposes exact station/EVSE identifiers and station-specific pricing
sourceModes.station_power: source exposes an exact station identifier and pricing by power/configuration
sourceModes.network_rule: official direct tariff grid applies to an explicitly identified customer-facing tariff network
sourceModes.reference_only: evidence is useful for display/audit but is not rankable
sourceModes.roaming: eMSP offer attached separately from the physical CPO direct tariff

offerFields.offerId: stable identifier inside the provider source
offerFields.physicalOperatorId: technical CPO identity when relevant; null for pure tariff-network templates
offerFields.tariffNetworkId: customer-facing network carrying the direct tariff
offerFields.canonicalPdcId: PAN-derived PDC id after matching when applicable
offerFields.selectors: optional explicit constraints such as department/site class/address/power
offerFields.rankable: false unless identity, match and tariff semantics are unambiguous

pricingRuleFields.chargeThresholdMinutes: elapsed charging time before chargePerMinute starts
pricingRuleFields.durationPerMinute: connection/session-duration fee distinct from post-charge occupancy
pricingRuleFields.durationThresholdMinutes: elapsed connection time before duration fee starts
pricingRuleFields.durationStart: optional clock-window start during which the duration surcharge is applied
pricingRuleFields.durationEnd: optional clock-window end during which the duration surcharge is applied
pricingRuleFields.occupancyThresholdMinutes: grace/threshold after charge end before occupancy fee
pricingRuleFields.occupancyStart: optional clock-window start for occupancy fee
pricingRuleFields.occupancyEnd: optional clock-window end for occupancy fee
pricingRuleFields.parkingPerMinute: parking fee only when explicitly part of charging transaction
pricingRuleFields.totalTransactionCap: optional cap applied to the complete charging transaction
pricingRuleFields.rounding: optional billing rounding rule such as started_kwh_and_started_minute
